limits: Both historical family/raw HOLDs remain preserved and are not upgraded by this different selected candidate.

The source actors are exceptionally small (6–10 painted Original cells). New material shading is visible at native3/4; this is a faithful tiny source treatment, not newly invented anatomy or enlarged collision geometry.
No live mission or difficulty reachability assertion. Original declarations and actual difficulty gates must be resolved separately by the gameplay/context owner.
This author cannot independently approve their own artwork; different ART peer and Root admission remain required.

Raw atlas is a literal block-silhouette interpretation with generated beveled/cloth-like material shading; it is not a detailed anatomical reinterpretation. That restrained treatment is intentional for only4x4 painted logical extent.

Untouched provider RGBA contains low-alpha ambient colored pixels outside its visible actor. Actual runtime thresholding discards this faint backing: native1 occupancy matches Source exactly; native2 masks are also exact nearest-Source, native3/4 contain only2–4edge-sample differences. All24 selected whole palette outputs show no detached glow, opaque rectangle or cast shadow.

The two returned duplicate-pose raw cells4/5 have their own material variations. They are preserved but not selected, not claimed pixel-identical and not credited as additional accepted artwork; final complete6 uses exact Source-identity cells2/1.
One Source central face4,3 perframe is functionally retained (180actual samples over all scales), with zero new generated-HD detail credit. No raw RGBA edits or cleanup occurred.
